# Bid the roof, not the floor plan.

> Price a residential reroof from roof squares, pitch, waste, and tear-off layers — labor, material, dump, overhead, and the walk-away number. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
